description: All Bundeswehr ranks of one service from lowest to highest, with abbreviation, rank group, level, NATO code and pay grade. Ranks on the same level are equal in rank (the officer candidates Fahnenjunker, Fähnrich and Oberfähnrich share a level with the rank below them).

service.description: heer_luftwaffe (Army and Air Force share their ranks), marine (Navy), sanitaet (medical officers)
